Founded in 1976 as Shree Jagannath Ferro Casting, JPK Metallics is a family-run foundry with nearly five decades of expertise in the iron casting industry. We have evolved into one of India’s leading manufacturers and exporters of ductile and grey iron castings.

The company is led by Mr. K.P. Agarwala (Chairman) and Mr. Punit Agarwala (Director), whose combined vision and leadership continue to drive JPK Metallics forward.

From our modern facility in Howrah, West Bengal, we proudly serve industries worldwide, building a reputation founded on dependability, transparency, and innovation. Our products power critical infrastructure across sanitation, construction, agriculture, railways, and industrial engineering sectors.

With alegacy spanning 50 years, JPK Metallics remains committed to pushing boundaries and setting new standards in the global iron casting market.

For five decades, the journey of JPK Metallics has been shaped by the people behind the business. Our team combines the judgement that experience brings with the drive to keep improving, bringing together professionals across foundry operations, engineering, quality assurance, supply chain and partner support.

What unites us is a shared belief that reliability is earned through transparency, discipline and consistency. Every process we follow, every standard we hold and every commitment we meet rests on the people who make it possible.

At JPK Metallics, we do not view our workforce as individuals performing separate functions. We see ourselves as one team working toward a common purpose: manufacturing world-class ductile iron casting solutions that contribute to critical infrastructure and industrial growth. Through collaboration, integrity, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, our team continues to drive the company’s growth while preserving the values on which it was founded.

intro.r0.default:
JPK Metallics is a family-run iron foundry with five decades of experience. From our 1,85,000 sq.ft. facility in Howrah, West Bengal, and our corporate office in Kolkata, our teams make ductile iron, grey cast iron and steel castings for customers around the world.

We look for people who take pride in their work, care about safety and quality, and want to keep learning. Whether you are starting out or bringing years of experience, you will find room to grow here.
